hook: This mistake costs dentists 4 chairs a week

beats.say: Four no shows yesterday. Four empty chairs I still paid my team for.
And the phone rang all weekend while we were closed. Nobody picked up.
Those patients just booked with whoever answered first.
Good morning, Doctor. That's two leaks in the same bucket. Let me plug both.
I'm Jarvis. First, after hours. Every call you miss gets a text from me within a minute. Research shows people who get a reply in the first five minutes are far more likely to book.
Six new patients booked. One had a cracked tooth, so I put him in your emergency slot at eight fifteen.
Every patient gets a reminder two days before and again that morning. If they can't come, I rebook them on the spot, and fill the gap from your waitlist.
So the chair doesn't sit empty.
Exactly. And your front desk never touches any of it.
If your office misses calls after hours, or loses money to no shows, DM the word BUILD, and Jarvis Works will build me for your practice.
